name: Virfice – Email Marketing & Automation for WordPress and WooCommerce
author: Virfice

sections.description:
Virfice is a self-hosted email marketing and automation plugin for WordPress and WooCommerce. Create newsletters, send targeted email campaigns, capture and manage subscribers, build automated workflows, customize transactional emails, and track campaign performance—all from your WordPress dashboard.

Unlike subscriber-based email marketing platforms, Virfice keeps your contacts and campaign data on your own WordPress site. There is no per-contact pricing or artificial subscriber limit. Connect your preferred SMTP provider and retain control of your audience, sending infrastructure, and email marketing data.

Get Virfice Pro | Documentation | Support

What Can You Do with Virfice?

🎨 Create and send targeted email marketing campaigns
🧲 Capture subscribers with customizable signup forms
🗂️ Organize and segment contacts using lists, tags, and custom fields
🔍 Target audiences with include/exclude filters
⏰ Send campaigns instantly or schedule them for later
🔁 Resend campaigns to non-openers
🤖 Automate emails based on WordPress and WooCommerce events
🛒 Recover abandoned carts with automated follow-up emails
👋 Create welcome, birthday, post-purchase, and customer-engagement workflows
🛍️ Send WooCommerce-triggered emails based on purchases, carts, and customer actions
🧾 Customize and fully brand WooCommerce transactional emails
📧 Customize WordPress system emails
📦 Design emails using ready-made templates and reusable content blocks
📊 Track deliveries, opens, clicks, bounces, and failures
✉️ Connect, configure, and test your preferred SMTP provider—no additional SMTP plugin required

A complete Self-Hosted Email Marketing Solution for WordPress

Virfice brings email marketing into WordPress, giving you direct control over your audience and campaign data. Your contacts remain on your website instead of being locked inside a third-party email marketing platform.

  • No per-subscriber or per-contact pricing.
  • No artificial limit on the number of contacts you can manage.
  • Send through your preferred SMTP or email delivery provider.
  • Keep your audience, campaigns, and marketing data in WordPress.
  • Manage newsletters, automations, forms, and transactional emails from one dashboard.

Your practical sending volume, deliverability, and sending costs depend on your hosting environment and chosen email delivery provider.

WordPress Newsletters and Email Campaigns

Create, design, schedule, and send newsletters without leaving WordPress. Use the visual email builder and ready-made templates for product updates, company news, offers, announcements, and regular subscriber newsletters.

Target the right audience using lists and tags, include or exclude specific subscriber groups, personalize email content, send immediately or schedule campaigns, and resend campaigns to contacts who did not open the original email.

Visual Email Builder

Create professional, responsive emails with a visual builder built directly into WordPress. Add and arrange content, personalize messages, apply global brand styles, and reuse sections to design faster while keeping your emails consistent.

  • Visual email-building experience.
  • Reusable ready blocks and content sections.
  • Professionally designed email templates.
  • Responsive email layouts.
  • Brand-wide header, footer, colors, and styles.
  • Dynamic placeholders for personalized content.
  • Email preview and test-email options.

Audience and Subscriber Management

Manage your email marketing audience directly inside WordPress.

  • Add and update contacts manually.
  • Import contacts from CSV files.
  • Export audience data.
  • Organize contacts with lists and tags.
  • Store custom contact fields.
  • Include or exclude audience groups from campaigns.
  • View and edit individual contact information.
  • Manage subscription and unsubscribe status.

Email Marketing Automation

Build event-based email automation workflows using triggers, conditions, delays, and actions. Automatically welcome subscribers, engage WordPress users, follow up with customers, recover abandoned carts, and deliver timely messages based on activity across your website.

Available Automation Triggers

Forms

  • Form Submitted

Users & Customers

  • New Signup
  • User Birthday
  • User Logged In

WooCommerce

  • Order Created
  • Order Paid
  • Order Processing
  • Order Completed
  • Order Cancelled
  • Order On Hold
  • Order Refunded
  • Order Pending Payment
  • Customer Account Created
  • Cart Abandoned

Use these triggers to create welcome emails, birthday emails, order follow-ups, post-purchase sequences, payment reminders, customer onboarding, cart-recovery campaigns, and other WordPress and WooCommerce email automations.

Abandoned Cart Recovery for WooCommerce

Recover potential sales with automated abandoned-cart emails. Virfice can initiate a workflow when a registered or guest customer’s cart becomes abandoned, allowing you to send timely reminders and guide the shopper back to checkout.

When an abandoned cart is purchased or emptied, its queued recovery workflow is cleared automatically, helping prevent unnecessary follow-up emails.

Lead Capture Forms

Grow your email list with customizable, mobile-friendly signup forms—without installing a separate form plugin. Capture leads directly in WordPress, collect custom information, and connect form submissions to your email marketing automations.

Email Analytics and Tracking

Track campaign delivery, opens, clicks, bounces, and failures from a centralized dashboard. Review campaign performance, understand subscriber engagement, and use the results to improve future newsletters and email campaigns.

Open and click tracking can be affected by recipient privacy features, email-client behavior, and other technical factors.

WordPress and WooCommerce Transactional Emails

Design and manage supported WordPress system emails and WooCommerce transactional emails from one visual interface. Apply your branding, customize the content, preview the result, and send test emails before using a design on your store.

Supported Emails

  • New Account Email – Welcome customers or WordPress users after account creation.
  • Reset Password Email – Customize password-reset messages.
  • New Order Email – Notify the store administrator when a new order is placed.
  • Cancelled Order Email – Notify the store administrator when an order is cancelled.
  • Failed Order Email – Notify the store administrator when an order fails.
  • Order On Hold Email – Update customers when an order is placed on hold.
  • Order Processing Email – Notify customers when an order is paid and processing.
  • Order Completed Email – Notify customers when an order is completed.
  • Order Refunded Email – Inform customers when an order is refunded.
  • Customer Invoice Email – Send order details and payment links when applicable.
  • Customer Note Email – Send notes added to a customer’s order.

Built-In SMTP Configuration

Connect your preferred SMTP service directly inside Virfice. Configure authentication, send a test email, and manage email delivery without installing an additional SMTP plugin.

Virfice does not operate an email delivery network. Actual delivery is handled by your configured SMTP or email service provider.

Virfice Free and Virfice Pro

Virfice Free includes the core tools available in the plugin downloaded from WordPress.org. Virfice Pro extends the platform with additional email marketing, automation, WooCommerce, and audience-management capabilities.

Feature availability may vary by plan and version. Visit the Virfice website for the current feature comparison.

How to Use Virfice

No coding or advanced technical knowledge is required.

  1. Install and activate Virfice.
  2. Open Virfice from your WordPress dashboard.
  3. Configure your sender information and preferred SMTP provider.
  4. Import or capture contacts and organize them with lists and tags.
  5. Design a newsletter, create a campaign, customize a transactional email, or build an automation workflow.
  6. Send a test email, review your settings, and activate or schedule your email.
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 5.5 or greater
  • PHP 7.3 or greater

WooCommerce 8.0 or greater is required only for WooCommerce-specific emails, triggers, and automation features.

Automatic Installation

  1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for Virfice.
  3. Click Install Now, then click Activate.
  4. Open Virfice from the WordPress dashboard to get started.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the Virfice plugin ZIP file.
  2. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Select the ZIP file and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin and open Virfice from the dashboard.
sections.faq:
What is Virfice?

Virfice is a self-hosted email marketing and automation plugin for WordPress and WooCommerce. It brings audience management, newsletters, email campaigns, forms, automations, transactional email customization, analytics, and SMTP configuration into your WordPress dashboard.

Is Virfice a WordPress newsletter plugin?

Yes. You can design, schedule, and send newsletters and targeted email campaigns directly from WordPress.

Does Virfice support email automation?

Yes. Virfice supports event-based automation workflows using triggers, conditions, delays, and actions. Available automation features may differ between Virfice Free and Virfice Pro.

Does Virfice support WooCommerce abandoned-cart recovery?

Yes. The Cart Abandoned trigger can start automated cart-recovery workflows for registered and guest customers. Queued recovery workflows are cleared when the customer purchases or empties the abandoned cart.

Can I use Virfice without WooCommerce?

Yes. Virfice can be used for WordPress newsletters, subscriber management, forms, campaigns, system emails, and automation. WooCommerce adds ecommerce-specific emails and automation triggers.

Does Virfice customize WooCommerce emails?

Yes. You can visually customize supported WooCommerce transactional emails, including new-order, processing-order, completed-order, refunded-order, customer-invoice, customer-note, new-account, and reset-password emails.

Where is my email marketing data stored?

Virfice is self-hosted. Contacts, lists, tags, campaigns, and related marketing data are stored on your WordPress website.

Does Virfice charge based on subscriber count?

Virfice does not charge based on the number of contacts stored in WordPress. Sending capacity and costs depend on your hosting environment and selected SMTP or email delivery provider.

Do I need a separate SMTP plugin?

No. Virfice includes SMTP configuration, allowing you to connect your preferred SMTP service and send a test email from the Virfice settings.

Is Virfice compatible with my WordPress theme?

Virfice-generated emails are not dependent on your active WordPress theme. Form appearance may be affected by styles applied by your theme.

Is there a premium version?

Yes. Virfice Free provides the features included in the WordPress.org download, while Virfice Pro adds advanced capabilities. Visit the Virfice website for the current feature comparison.

Where can I get support or request a feature?

Use the WordPress.org support forum for the free plugin or contact Virfice support to report an issue or request a feature.
